  • Architect and deliver scalable, secure, and performant solutions in green-field and ongoing projects.
  • Build applications in Java, Node.js and Python .
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, AI debugging tools, etc) to speed up development, improve documentation, and optimise workflows.
  • Collaborate directly with clients to gather requirements, provide technical guidance, and deliver value.
  • Define engineering best practices, technical roadmaps, and solution design standards.
  • Mentor engineers and foster a culture of experimentation, quality, and continuous learning.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of professional experience in software engineering with strong Java expertise.
  • Working knowledge of Node.js and Python .
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering green-field projects.
  • Strong grasp of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Comfortable and proactive in using AI tools for coding, documentation, testing, and prototyping .
  • Excellent communication skills in English, written and spoken.
  • Ability to work directly with clients in a consultative and collaborative manner.

Desirable

  • Experience in high-autonomy/startup environments.
  • Familiarity with microservices, Docker/Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Exposure to AI/ML project work (bonus but not required).

What we offer

  • International projects with heavy use of AI-assisted workflows.
  • A role where you can architect solutions from the ground up.
  • Flexible, remote work environment built on trust.
  • A small, collaborative, and forward-thinking technical team.
  • Real opportunities to influence product direction and company decisions.

Company Description

TechVantage Solutions is a New Zealand-based software consultancy specializing in software development outsourcing and engineering team augmentation. We empower businesses from fast-moving startups to global enterprises to build, scale, and deliver high-quality software with speed and confidence. We have partnered with companies around the world, including those serving Fortune 500 clients, to solve complex technical challenges and accelerate delivery. At TechVantage, we bridge the gap between business and technology, delivering scalable, world-class solutions from New Zealand.

title: Senior Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .

About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).

Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support

If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Infraestrutura Especialista (SRE)
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

O DESAFIO:

● Planejar, implantar e manter a infraestrutura necessária para o pipeline de dados, incluindo servidores, containers ou clusters (por exemplo, configuração de clusters Spark/Databricks, instâncias de banco de dados PostgreSQL, clusters MongoDB e brokers Kafka), seja em ambiente de nuvem ou on-premises, garantindo configurações adequadas de alta disponibilidade e redundância.

● Desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para automação de deploy das aplicações e componentes de dados (serviços Java, notebooks Databricks, configurações de bancos), promovendo entregas constantes e confiáveis sem interrupção do serviço.

● Implementar soluções de monitoramento, logging e alerta para todos os componentes da plataforma (uso de ferramentas como Prometheus/Grafana, ELK Stack ou equivalentes), garantindo observabilidade completa do sistema (métricas de performance, falhas, latências, utilização de recursos) e resposta rápida a incidentes.

● Trabalhar junto aos engenheiros de dados e desenvolvedores para melhorar a confiabilidade das aplicações, revisando configurações, identificando pontos únicos de falha e implementando soluções de resiliência (como balanceamento de carga, retries automáticos, fallback).

● Gerenciar a segurança e conformidade da infraestrutura, aplicando atualizações de sistema, patches de segurança, configurações de firewall e acessos apropriados, em alinhamento com políticas corporativas e requisitos (por exemplo, LGPD).

● Otimizar a performance e custo da infraestrutura, monitorando uso de recursos e escalando ambientes conforme necessidade (vertical ou horizontalmente), bem como implementando rotinas de housekeeping (expurgo de logs, archiving de dados) para manter o ambiente saudável.

● Liderar a resposta a incidentes críticos relacionados à infraestrutura ou disponibilidade dos sistemas de dados, investigando raiz de problemas (post- mortem) e implementando ações preventivas para evitar recorrências.

O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

● Domínio de sistemas operacionais Linux e competências em automação de infraestrutura (shell scripting, Python) e infraestrutura como código (Terraform, CloudFormation ou similares).

● Conhecimento sólido em ferramentas de containerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) para gerir serviços containerizados e escalar aplicações.

● Experiência com plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) ou com ambientes virtualizados on-premises, compreendendo rede, armazenamento e computação, e habilidade para configurar serviços como bancos de dados gerenciados, balanceadores de carga, etc.

● Prática em configurar e manter ferramentas de monitoramento e logging (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, CloudWatch, etc.) e interpretar métricas para troubleshooting.

● Familiaridade com conceitos de SRE, incluindo definição de SLOs/SLAs, error budget, e experiência em protocolos de resposta a incidentes.

VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Experiência no mercado financeiro

O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Social Media Content Creator (Do Not Quick Apply)
description:
Brand Storyteller

(Full-Time Contractor · Remote · BestLyfe Group) About the Role

BestLyfe Group (BLG) is on the hunt for a world-class Brand Storyteller — someone who lives and breathes content, strategy, and data. You’ll be the creative force behind the social presence of three powerhouse brands:

  • Dustin Lunde (our fearless founder)
  • Lyfe by the Horns (our unapologetically real podcast and brand)
  • BestLyfe Group (our marketing agency changing how businesses grow)

Your mission? Build authority, drive engagement, and make people feel something when they see our content. You’ll co-create strategy with leadership, manage execution across every platform, and bring the kind of creative energy that makes people stop scrolling and start following.

This isn’t a “post pretty graphics and call it a day” gig. This is brand building at its finest — story, psychology, timing, and metrics all rolled into one.

What You’ll Do
  • Develop and execute a holistic content strategy across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, and Threads
  • Collaborate directly with leadership to create high-impact content campaigns for BLG, LBTH, and Dustin’s personal brand
  • Edit short- and long-form videos, design graphics, and produce thumb-stopping creative assets
  • Write witty, on-brand copy that captures our tone — bold, self-aware, real
  • Analyze performance data and adjust strategy to improve engagement, reach, and conversion
  • Manage posting schedules and platform optimizations
  • Repurpose content across platforms to maximize visibility and ROI
  • Collaborate with our current editor during the transition period for consistent quality and brand cohesion
Who You Are
  • A creative weapon — equal parts strategist, designer, editor, and storyteller
  • Obsessed with social media trends, but smart enough to know when to lead instead of follow
  • Fluent in Canva, Adobe Suite, or CapCut, and capable of building content that looks as good as it performs
  • Analytical enough to make data sexy — and creative enough to turn insights into action
  • A self-starter who thrives in autonomy, takes initiative, and communicates like a pro
  • Hungry, curious, and coachable — talent and drive matter more to us than titles or years of experience
The BLG Culture (Read Carefully)

We’re not looking for average.

Average doesn’t last here.

BLG is a no-BS, high-performance culture built on creativity, accountability, and excellence. We don’t do drama, excuses, or clock-watchers. We do bold ideas, ownership, and growth.

If you love creating, want to be part of something that’s actually going somewhere , and thrive under leadership that challenges and believes in you — you’ll fit right in.

If you need hand-holding, constant direction, or approval for every idea — this isn’t your gig.

Why BLG

Because we’re building something real.

You’ll work directly with the founder, get exposure to multiple brands, and have the freedom to test, create, and evolve — all while being part of a team that’s redefining what marketing should feel like.

How to Apply

Na Apsen Farmacêutica, cada detalhe importa, desde a pesquisa até o produto final que chega à casa de milhares de brasileiros.

Sua missão

  • Realizar e avaliar atividades com impacto nos produtos, documentos e processos de qualidade, seguindo procedimentos operacionais e as Boas Práticas de Fabricação, com o objetivo de atender as legislações vigentes e garantir a qualidade do produto de saúde animal final. .

O que você vai fazer

  • Realizar auditorias nacionais e internacionais em fornecedores, de acordo com Programa de Qualificação estabelecido, em uma frequência suficiente que possa determinar se o fornecedor está em conformidade com procedimentos e legislações e apto a fornecer materiais e serviços à Apsen.
  • Planejar e ministrar treinamentos definidos na matriz de treinamentos relacionados à atividades de qualidade, a fim de capacitar os colaboradores e prestadores de serviços que executam atividades relacionadas aos procedimentos de qualidade, bem como garantir que os novos funcionários compreendam as Boas Práticas de Fabricação e demais legislações vigentes para produtos para saúde animal.
  • Realizar e controlar o andamento das atividades de Qualidade, por meio de indicadores mensais visando cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos e atividades propostas.

Ensino Superior Completo

Cursos: Médico Veterinário, Farmacêutico ou Químico.

title: Analista Middleware/SRE Openshift - SR
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa dedicada e com vontade de fazer a diferença para atuar na área de Middleware/SRE. Se você ama tecnologia, gosta de desafios e acredita no poder da colaboração para alcançar grandes resultados, essa oportunidade é para você!

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência em OpenShift/Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em administração de clusters OpenShift, incluindo criação e gerenciamento de projetos, deployments, pods, services, ingress/routes e operators.
  • Configuração de Alta Disponibilidade
  • Experiência em orquestração de aplicações em containers, garantindo alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade por meio de réplicas, HPA (Horizontal Pod Autoscaler) e balanceamento de carga nativo do OpenShift.
  • Otimização de Desempenho (Tuning);
  • Ajustes de recursos (requests/limits de CPU e memória), otimização de JVMs em aplicações containerizadas, configuração de probes (liveness/readiness) e afinamento de conexões para melhorar resiliência e performance.
  • Scripting e Automação (CLI e GitOps)
  • Habilidade em automação de tarefas usando oc CLI, YAML/Helm Charts e integração com GitOps (ArgoCD/Tekton) para pipelines de CI/CD e monitoramento contínuo.
  • Integração com Banco de Dados
  • Configuração de secrets e configMaps para conexão segura com bancos de dados (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.), além de otimização de conexões e uso de serviços externos com Service Binding.
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas Operacionais e Containers
  • Proficiência em Linux, containers Docker/CRI-O, namespaces, segurança com SELinux e controle de recursos no ambiente de execução.
  • Noções de Redes e Segurança
  • Entendimento de service mesh (como Istio/OpenShift Service Mesh), TLS/SSL, Network Policies e autenticação/autorização com OpenShift OAuth e RBAC para garantir segurança de aplicações e comunicação entre serviços.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas
  • Análise rápida de falhas em containers, pods e pipelines, com uso de ferramentas como oc logs, oc describe e observabilidade integrada (Prometheus, Grafana, EFK/ELK).
  • Gestão do Tempo e Priorização
  • Organização para lidar com múltiplos projetos e demandas simultâneas em ambientes críticos, priorizando de acordo com impacto ao negócio.
  • Colaboração e Trabalho em Equipe
  • Interação com desenvolvedores, SREs, arquitetos de soluções e equipes de segurança para garantir entrega contínua e integração fluida no cluster.

title: Head of Brazil Financial Shared Service Center - Midea Group (Fortune 500)
description:
Company Overview

Midea Group, a globally renowned Fortune 500 enterprise, is a leader in the home appliance and consumer electronics industry with a strong presence across over 200 countries and regions. We are now seeking a high-caliber professional to lead our Brazil Financial Shared Service Center (FSSC), driving operational excellence and supporting the group’s strategic development in the Brazilian market.

Job Location

R. Sen. Milton Campos, 145 - 3º Andar - Vila da Serra, Nova Lima - MG, , Brasil

Job Responsibilities

  1. Oversee the daily operation and management of Brazil FSSC, ensuring compliance with internal policies, local regulations, and global financial standards.
  2. Coordinate closely with FSSC-serviced business units (BUs) in Brazil to align service priorities, resolve operational issues, and guarantee the efficiency and quality of FSSC services .
  3. Establish effective communication and collaboration mechanisms with each FSSC module at Midea Group Headquarters (HQ), ensuring seamless integration of global financial processes and local operational needs.
  4. Lead the building, development, and performance management of the Brazil FSSC team, including talent recruitment, training, goal setting, and performance evaluation, to enhance team capability and engagement.
  5. Serve as the key coordinator for internal and external audits (e.g., statutory audits, internal financial audits), organize audit preparations, provide required materials, and follow up on audit findings to complete audit projects smoothly.
  6. Implement key financial initiatives and projects as assigned by HQ (e.g., system optimization, process reengineering), ensuring on-time delivery and alignment with the group’s financial strategy.

Requirements & Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above in Accounting, Finance, or related fields , with solid professional knowledge of accounting standards (e.g., IFRS, Brazilian local accounting standards) and financial operations.
  2. Fluent English (both written and spoken) as the working language; proficiency in Mandarin Chinese is mandatory (for communication with HQ); knowledge of Portuguese is highly preferred.
  3. Deep understanding of Brazilian business culture, local tax regulations, and financial compliance requirements ; prior experience in the Brazilian market is a plus.
  4. Strong leadership and team management skills , with a proven track record of leading and motivating cross-functional teams. Excellent relationship-building abilities to collaborate with internal stakeholders (HQ, local BUs) and external parties (auditors, regulators).
  5. Self-driven, results-oriented, and capable of strategic planning, organizational coordination, and working under pressure to meet tight deadlines.
  6. Prior team leadership experience (preferably in financial shared services, accounting, or finance departments) is highly preferred.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work with a Fortune 500 company and contribute to its global financial strategy.
  • A competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
  • Clear career development paths and access to global training resources.
  • A dynamic, inclusive, and collaborative work environment.

If you meet the above requirements and are eager to take on this challenging role, please submit your resume and cover letter via LinkedIn . We look forward to welcoming you to Midea’s global team!

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech (6 Month FTC)
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours. We are feeding the world’s curiosity! Job Description

Please note this is a 6-month fixed-term contract role.

The Opportunity

Are you passionate about recruiting top talent for Tech and Product roles? Join our global business at Cint as a Talent Acquisition Partner, where you will support our R&D (Tech and Product) teams. Our Talent Acquisition (TA) function is critical to our success, as it enables us to attract and hire the right talent that drives our business forward. In this role, you will proactively manage the recruitment process, working closely with business leaders to attract and hire the best candidates for our commercial and finance functions.

The Team

You will be part of an established global TA team comprising both technical and non-technical recruiters. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, where we support one another, share information, and celebrate successes. We continuously evaluate and improve our processes to ensure we remain at the forefront of talent acquisition.

Join us at Cint and be a part of a dynamic team that plays a vital role in our global success. If you are ready to take on the challenge and drive the recruitment of top technical talent, apply now!

What You Will Do

  • Full-Cycle Recruitment: Lead and execute the entire recruitment process for roles within our Tech and Product functions.
  • Consultative Partnership: Work closely with hiring managers, People Partners, and Finance Partners to share industry trends, compensation insights, and competitor updates.
  • Educate Hiring Managers: Provide guidance on best practices, recruitment strategies, and process improvements to enhance their hiring practices.
  • End-to-End Process Management: Manage all aspects of the hiring process, including writing job advertisements, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, arranging interviews, and extending job offers.
  • ATS Management: Maintain and update our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) – SmartRecruiters.
  • Support DEI: Promote and support Cint’s commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) through continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Continuous Improvement: Engage in projects with the TA team to implement process changes that enhance our ability to identify and attract talent.
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Analyze your performance metrics to identify strengths and areas for development, and share these insights with the team.
Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: Proven experience in a talent acquisition/recruiting role, managing end-to-end recruitment for commercial vacancies in Brazil/North America.
  • Commercial & Finance Insight: Understanding the importance of the Tech/Engineering and Product functions within a global business.
  • ATS Proficiency: Ability to maintain and manage an accurate ATS.
  • Data-Driven Approach: Ability to analyze performance metrics and use data to drive recruitment strategies.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Strong team player who can collaborate effectively to address challenges and develop solutions.
  • Proactive Sourcing: Willingness to source candidates proactively to find the right expertise.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • ATS Experience: Previous experience using the Smart Recruiters ATS.
Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (

title: Country Operations Manager
description:
Country Operations Manager – LATAM

Location: Brazil/ Remote

Job Type: Full-time contract

About Trantor Inc

Trantor Inc. is a global technology services and consulting company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, with delivery centers across the USA, Canada, and India. We partner with Fortune 500 companies and high-growth enterprises to drive digital transformation through Product Engineering, Cloud Enablement, Data & AI Solutions, Automation, and Customer Success Services. At Trantor, we thrive in a collaborative, agile, and people-first environment.

Why Join Trantor?

Trantor offers the opportunity to work on diverse, cutting-edge projects in a culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote role while contributing to impactful initiatives in a truly global organization.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Country Manager – LATAM to lead and scale our operations across the region. This role is 80% operations-focused, with responsibility for resource management, workforce planning, employee engagement, HR, HR compliance, and strategic growth. The remaining 20% requires technical acumen to manage tech people, understand how tech operations are run, and participate in technical discussions with clients.

The right candidate will have proven experience in managing, scaling, and setting up IT/Tech teams, ensuring smooth delivery and operational excellence. They must be adept at building and inspiring high-performing teams, driving compliance and retention, and cultivating trusted long-term relationships with clients and stakeholders.

What’s Exciting About This Role?

  • Lead and shape our entire LATAM operation, with the autonomy to make high-impact decisions.
  • Build and inspire a high-performing, multicultural team while forging strong client relationships.
  • Play a pivotal role in driving operational excellence and market presence.
  • Work in a fast-paced, global environment where your ideas are implemented, not just discussed.

Key Responsibilities

, HR & Resource Management

  • Oversee all LATAM resources to ensure productivity and quality.
  • Manage the full employee lifecycle including hiring, onboarding, HR compliance, and performance management.
  • Monitor attrition rates and implement proactive retention strategies.
  • Drive employee satisfaction through engagement programs, career development, and structured feedback channels.

Tech Operations Oversight

  • Manage and scale tech operations and delivery teams .
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical delivery.
  • Provide credible oversight in technical discussions with clients.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Engagement
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers across LATAM.
  • Act as the primary liaison for client needs, service delivery, and customer success.
  • Represent the company at local and regional events, forums, and client meetings.

Operational Leadership & Strategic Growth

  • Lead daily operations, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and alignment with corporate policies.
  • Collaborate with HR, Finance, and global teams for seamless cross-functional workflows.
  • Monitor performance metrics and provide regular updates to regional/global leadership.
  • Adapt and execute market-specific strategies aligned with global objectives.

Financial & Market Insight Contribution

  • Support budget planning, resource allocation, and cost optimization.
  • Provide local market intelligence to inform global strategic decisions.

Key Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience: 8–12 years in senior leadership or country management, preferably in the IT/Consulting sector.
  • People & HR Management: Proven success in leading teams, driving workforce planning, employee engagement, HR processes, and HR compliance , with measurable improvement in retention.
  • Tech Operations Oversight: Demonstrated ability to set up, scale, and manage IT/Tech teams (Must Have)

  • Strategic & Operational Skills: Ability to translate business objectives into actionable operational and delivery plans, while ensuring compliance and efficiency.
  • Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required; Spanish and Portuguese proficiency are strong advantages.
  • Technical Tools: Familiarity with CRM systems, business management platforms, and performance reporting tools.

Why Join Us?

  • Strategic leadership role with direct impact on our LATAM operations
  • Competitive remuneration (salary only)
  • Work within a global and fast-growing organization
  • Friendly, supportive, positive, and professional team of experts
  • Multicultural and diverse environment
  • Full-time employment
  • Remote work conditions

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity! Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.

We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.

  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

  • applications

  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments

  • Proactive and enthusiastic

title: Bolsista Doutor - Digital Care 2 You- Aplicação de Inteligência Artificial na Jornada do paciente | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Digital Care 2 You é uma healthtech comprometida com a transformação digital da saúde pública e suplementar por meio da inovação responsável. Atuamos com soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, Big Data e interoperabilidade de sistemas, com foco em segurança clínica, ética, conformidade e impacto real na jornada do paciente.

Nosso propósito é claro: ampliar o acesso, a precisão e a qualidade do cuidado por meio da tecnologia, sempre respeitando os princípios éticos e os marcos legais da área da saúde.


Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Bioinformática, Inteligência Artificial Aplicada, áreas afins.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Projeto: Aplicação de Inteligência Artificial na Jornada do paciente.


Principais Atividades:

· Mapeamento e análise de requisitos com times multiprofissionais.

· Integração de dados.

· Desenvolvimento e validação de modelos de IA em saúde.

· Criação de ferramentas automatizadas.

· Avaliação contínua de impacto, performance e acurácia dos modelos de IA.

· Elaboração de documentação técnica e treinamentos para equipes de tecnologia e saúde.

· Garantia de segurança, anonimização, ética e conformidade com a LGPD e boas práticas de IA.


Conhecimento necessário:

· Domínio de Python, R, Java Script, SQL, React, Node ou similares e bibliotecas de IA.

· Experiência com integração de dados em saúde e padrões de interoperabilidade.

· Portfólio técnico ou publicações científicas em projetos de IA em saúde.

· Conhecimento da LGPD e princípios éticos para uso de IA.

Conhecimento desejável:

· Experiência com projetos na área de saúde.

· Participação em iniciativas nacionais ou internacionais de interoperabilidade.

· Certificações técnicas.

· Idioma: Inglês.

title: Drupal Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:


Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?


  • Develop Drupal solutions and custom features based on the Drupal framework (not Symfony);
  • Ensure proper implementation of legacy rules, including correct use of Drupal, security best practices, SEO, and configuration management;
  • Perform unit tests and integration tests;
  • Write and maintain technical documentation (SharePoint, Confluence, Visio);
  • Handle incident resolution and provide user support;
  • 3+ years of experience with Drupal 8–10 development;
  • Proficiency in JavaScript and HTML for front-end development;
  • Experience with Linux and Windows environments;
  • Familiarity with PHPStorm and/or VS Code IDEs;
  • Solid knowledge of PostgreSQL .
  • Experience using Git , GitLab , Jenkins , Artifactory , JIRA , XRAY , and SonarQube .
  • Good level of English, at least B2 (Mandatory);
  • Willingness to move to Portugal (Mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?


  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?


  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you at


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for one year period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Senior Recruitment Consultant – International Projects, Remote (Brazil Based)
description:
Are you a standout recruitment professional who’s passionate about business development and building lasting client partnerships? Do you love working with autonomy—yet crave the energy and support of a best-in-class, international team? If you’re ready for your career to go global, your opportunity starts here.


Remote People isn’t just another agency—we’re the bridge connecting exceptional talent with future-focused companies in over 150 countries. We build world-class teams, drive innovation, and empower growth for clients and candidates across the globe with tailored, fully compliant solutions.

If you’re energized by global impact, empowered by autonomy, and eager to work alongside the best in international recruiting—apply now . Join Remote People and help us shape the future of talent across the Americas and beyond.

title: Senior Software Engineer (L5)
description:
Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.


Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!


What is the role?

We are looking for a senior engineer with backend experience, who will join our team mainly focused on backend development, always focusing on delivering applications for high traffic access, well-monitored and fully tested. You will be responsible for the entire development lifecycle. In our team, everyone has the opportunity to share ideas, bring new solutions, and discuss them with other well-experienced engineers.


In this role you'll:

  • Write secure, efficient, and high-quality code that adheres to best practices, such as encryption of sensitive data and input validation.
  • Develop scalable and reusable code that promotes efficient development, such as creating reusable libraries and components.
  • Identify areas for improvement in the codebase and take ownership of small-to-medium-sized systems, such as fixing bugs and optimizing performance.
  • Quickly understand documentation and utilize testing techniques, such as unit testing, integration testing, and stress testing, to ensure high-quality code.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders, such as providing regular status updates and actively seeking feedback.
  • Adapt to roadblocks and proactively resolve issues, such as debugging and troubleshooting.
  • Align work with customer value by using feedback to prioritize features.
  • Balance priorities and seek guidance when needed to make informed decisions.


What You’ll Bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building production web applications in an agile, startup environment.
  • 3+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails.
  • Experience migrating domains from monolithic to microservices.
  • Experience working with systems at scale utilizing microservices, AWS services
  • Interest in learning or exposure to event-based architecture
  • Team player mentality: high collaborative, documentation-focused and recognizing how to balance asynchronous communications and virtual meetings
  • A passion for solving complex technical problems in both new and legacy codebases.
  • A mindset of leaving the codebase better than how you found it.
  • Experience collaborating with multiple team members with varying experience levels to design and implement technical projects.
  • Ability to work and problem-solve independently.
  • A humble, collaborative, customer-focused, and highly curious approach to problem-solving.


Nice to have:

  • Golang experience


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Administrador de dados
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Customização e evolução da ferramenta de glossário de termos, alinhando a conceitos de domínios e capacidades do framework BIAN,

Desenvolver e aplicar regras na ferramenta de pré validação de modelos de dados utilizando Regex em C#,

Apoiar o time de Governança de Dados na adoção dos padrões BIAN,

Administrar e modelar dados (conceitual, lógica e física),

Apoiar iniciativas de governança de dados,

Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, analistas e equipes de desenvolvimento.


Habilidades e Requisitos


Experiência sólida em administração e modelagem de dados,

Conhecimento prático em automação processos e ferramentas de IA

Conhecimento na esteira CI/CD,

Familiaridade com ferramentas de modelagem como Erwin ou similares,

Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL,

Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas,

Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


What will you do:

  • Develop a revolutionary system for qualifying autonomous vehicles, and be involved in changing the world…
  • Work closely with designers, product managers, and development teams to create elegant, usable, responsive, and interactive interfaces
  • Be part of the applications group and have a major role in building the web infrastructure of Foretellix products
  • Take full ownership of front end projects from design and architecture to implementation
  • Build reusable code and libraries for future use
  • Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs


Requirements:

***Please send your CV in English

  • At least 6 years of experience developing large-scale, production-grade web front-end systems using JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • B.Sc. in Computer-Science /-Engineering, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Deep knowledge of and proven experience with the React.js framework and its ecosystem.
  • Capable of working independently and managing requirements from multiple stakeholders
  • Self-learner, highly motivated, and self-paced
  • Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.


Advantages:

  • Experience with developing complex business logic at an enterprise scale
  • Experience with Redux
  • Knowledge and skills in user experience (UX) design
  • Experience with visualization libraries such as DeckGL, Chart.js

title: Inside Sales Account Executive, North America
description:
Location: anywhere in LATAM


JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :


  • Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Craft and execute your territory sales plan & progress opportunities in the pipeline.
  • Provide product demos to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians in North America.
  • Proactively communicate with clients and users through emails and calls.
  • Analyze trends and make data driven decisions on priorities in your work.
  • Work effectively with other teams such as marketing to deliver on sales targets, team projects and campaigns.


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
  • Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Experienced with Salesforce and platforms such as Hubspot.
  • Confidence in dealing with clients and product users.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, results-oriented and willing to learn new skills.
  • A drive to succeed and a proven ability to be resilient and overcome challenges.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package including unlimited commissions on your sales
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack JR
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa desenvolvedora júnior para atuar no desenvolvimento de software com acompanhamento de profissionais experientes. Foco em aprendizado prático, execução de tarefas e entrega com qualidade, seguindo padrões e boas práticas da equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Implementar partes específicas do código sob supervisão, seguindo padrões técnicos e boas práticas.
  • Corrigir bugs e desenvolver pequenas melhorias e funcionalidades.
  • Participar das cerimônias do time (Refinamento, Daily, Review e Retrospectiva).
  • Manter tarefas e histórico atualizados nas ferramentas de gestão de projetos.
  • Documentar o que foi desenvolvido e decisões técnicas relevantes.
  • Realizar e apoiar testes com orientação do time, garantindo a qualidade das entregas.
  • Buscar aprendizado contínuo e evoluir a partir de feedbacks.


Requisitos e competências:

  • Fundamentos de programação e noções dos frameworks e ferramentas do projeto.
  • Capacidade de seguir instruções, processos e diretrizes técnicas.
  • Proatividade para pedir ajuda, tirar dúvidas e aprender com feedbacks.
  • Colaboração, comunicação e trabalho em equipe.
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em NET Core (C#)
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em Angular
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em GitLab
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em SQL Server
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em Cypress para testes automatizados


Diferenciais:

  • Mobile: experiência com Flutter ou interesse comprovado em desenvolvimento mobile.
  • Cloud: noções de Google Cloud (deploy, serviços gerenciados, CI/CD).
  • Segurança: familiaridade com SAST/DAST, boas práticas de AppSec e OWASP Top 10.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

title: Murex BAU Consultant
description:
Project Description

BAU Support - 1st and 2nd level production system support on Murex 3.1


Responsibilities

• Work on a variety of Murex system implementation, configuration and developments in various aspects of Murex including datamart, MXML pre-trade and post-trade workflows, RTBS and MDCS

• Coordinate and communicate with business and IT stakeholders to gather, document and verify requirements

• Analyse and make recommendations based on related Murex implementation experience

• Follow client SDLC lifecycle and documentation requirements

• Support IT and business audits and technology risk assessments

• Development and testing of database and infrastructure changes

• Perform technical reviews of production changes

• Write clear and concise documentation of issues and resolution within confluence

• Maintain and enhance the Control-M scheduling tool for intraday and end of day batches

• Deal directly with business users across the bank including front, middle and back office, finance, product control and risk to analyse and diagnose business critical issues

• Analyse and resolve issues related to risk, pricing, PnL, market data, market operations, EOD, interfaces, reporting

• Provides detailed information about issues to the vendor, and co-ordinates with them in testing fixes / solutions

• Acts as an intermediary between business and vendor

• Debug and enhance bespoke java processes supporting the Murex implementation


Qualifications

Minimum 2 years experience with Murex in a support capacity

Strong technical capability

Solid understanding of datamart

title: Cloud Platform Developer/Python
description:
Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.


Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Full Stack Developer Sênior/Especialista
description:
Como Full Stack Developer Especialista na Sankhya, você faz parte do time de tecnologia e inovação, sua missão será usar suas habilidades para criar, implementar e manter soluções de ponta a ponta que atendam às necessidades de nossos usuários. Trabalhamos com foco em colaboração, governança, segurança e performance para entregar produtos impactantes e de alta qualidade.


Nosso #Tech Team é um dos times chaves que fazem acontecer dentro da Sankhya. Por causa desta galera cheia de criatividade e, com muita sede de desenvolvimento (literalmente), oferecemos cada dia mais um software completo interativo que guia nossos clientes com muita inovação e gestão inteligente!


Aqui na Sankhya buscamos novas formas de solução, que sejam menos complexas, autênticas e únicas. E com isso queremos pessoas que desejem crescer a cada dia junto com a empresa, ajudando a gente a construir cada vez mais um ambiente diverso e de crescimento acelerado.


Responsabilidades:

  • Participar ativamente de discussões de produto, colaborando com Product Managers e stakeholders para identificar necessidades e propor soluções;
  • Projetar e implementar interfaces web responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando React;
  • Desenvolver APIs e microserviços escaláveis e performáticos com Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI);
  • Integrar soluções de backend e frontend de maneira eficiente, garantindo usabilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de CI/CD para automação de deploys e testes;
  • Implementar práticas de segurança, desempenho e monitoramento em aplicações web;
  • Validar e adaptar componentes de acordo com feedbacks dos usuários;
  • Documentar arquiteturas, fluxos e boas práticas para facilitar a colaboração e manutenção do código;
  • Colaborar com times multifuncionais para garantir a qualidade e inovação tecnológica.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Um Especialista em Exchange.


Habilidades necessária:


  • Experiência na indústria com produtos Microsoft, desenvolvimento de sistemas, operações de rede e suporte de software, além de consultoria de TI.

CLT FULL + Benefícios

Contrato híbrido para **eventuais** viagens e visitas a cliente.

· Convênio com Farmácia;

· Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;

· Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

title: CRM Architect
description:
We are currently looking for a seasoned CRM Architect to join our dynamic team. This remote role is an exciting opportunity for a professional with a strong background in Microsoft Dynamics CRM development and leadership skills. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of CRM architecture, be experienced in crafting customer-facing pages, and be adept at leading a team of junior developers. As a key player in our organization, you will drive the development and integration of CRM solutions to enhance our customer engagement and streamline business processes.


Job Duties and Responsibilities:


- Lead the development and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics CRM solutions, ensuring alignment with business goals and user needs.

- Design, build, and maintain customer-facing pages on the CRM Portal using both out-of-the-box capabilities and customizations.

- Oversee the CRM data model creation and participate actively in its design and maintenance.

- Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and provide expert guidance on best practices in CRM development.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate CRM with Azure, Power Automate, and other essential systems.

- Develop and deploy custom applications within Dynamics CRM, ensuring high performance and adherence to business requirements.

- Facilitate seamless integration of CRM with other systems, ensuring data consistency and accessibility.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to the CRM environment.

- Keep abreast of new CRM features and technologies, advocating for the adoption of innovations that can benefit the organization.


Qualifications:


- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- 5-12 years of experience in CRM development, with a focus on Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

- Proven track record as a lead developer with experience in guiding and mentoring junior team members.

- Strong understanding of CRM architecture and data modeling principles.

- Professional experience in developing CRM Portals with a blend of out-of-the-box and custom solutions.

- Expertise in HTML, JavaScript, and CSS for portal development.


Preferred Skills and Knowledge:


- Certifications in Microsoft Dynamics CRM are highly desirable.

- Knowledge of Power Automate and its integration with Dynamics CRM.

- Experience in creating apps within the Dynamics CRM platform.

- Familiarity with Azure and its services related to CRM integration.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment.


Tools and Technologies:


- Microsoft Dynamics CRM

- Power Portals

- HTML, JavaScript, CSS, c# .Net

- Azure Services

- Power Automate

- Integration and API development tools


As a CRM Developer, you will be at the forefront of our CRM initiatives, driving innovation and excellence. If you are a technical expert with a passion for leading development projects and a knack for solving complex problems, we would love to hear from you. Join us in delivering exceptional CRM solutions that power our business success.

- Design, build, and maintain customer-facing pages on the CRM Portal using both out-of-the-box capabilities and customizations.

- Oversee the CRM data model creation and participate actively in its design and maintenance.

- Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and provide expert guidance on best practices in CRM development.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate CRM with Azure, Power Automate, and other essential systems.

- Develop and deploy custom applications within Dynamics CRM, ensuring high performance and adherence to business requirements.

- Facilitate seamless integration of CRM with other systems, ensuring data consistency and accessibility.

- Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to the CRM environment.

- Keep abreast of new CRM features and technologies, advocating for the adoption of innovations that can benefit the organization.


Qualifications:


- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- 5-12 years of experience in CRM development, with a focus on Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

- Proven track record as a lead developer with experience in guiding and mentoring junior team members.

- Strong understanding of CRM architecture and data modeling principles.

- Professional experience in developing CRM Portals with a blend of out-of-the-box and custom solutions.

- Expertise in HTML, JavaScript, and CSS for portal development.


Preferred Skills and Knowledge:


- Certifications in Microsoft Dynamics CRM are highly desirable.

- Knowledge of Power Automate and its integration with Dynamics CRM.

- Experience in creating apps within the Dynamics CRM platform.

- Familiarity with Azure and its services related to CRM integration.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

- Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment.


Tools and Technologies:


- Microsoft Dynamics CRM

- Power Portals

- HTML, JavaScript, CSS, c# .Net

- Azure Services

- Power Automate

- Integration and API development tools


As a CRM Developer, you will be at the forefront of our CRM initiatives, driving innovation and excellence. If you are a technical expert with a passion for leading development projects and a knack for solving complex problems, we would love to hear from you. Join us in delivering exceptional CRM solutions that power our business success.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Turing is seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer, Integrated Marketing to produce visually compelling designs across diverse marketing channels. This role focuses on creating on-brand advertising campaigns, presentation templates, brand guidelines, digital assets, and integrated marketing initiatives.

Collaborating closely with marketing designers embedded across business units, you’ll maintain and evolve Turing’s visual identity, leveraging the latest creative tools and staying ahead of design trends to deliver exceptional brand experiences.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and Production: Create compelling graphics and creative assets for integrated marketing initiatives including advertising campaigns, social media, email, presentations, digital content, and events.
  • Brand Consistency: Support and evolve Turing’s visual design system and brand guidelines, maintaining templates, design libraries, and visual standards across internal and external communications.
  • Collaboration and Alignment: Partner closely with embedded marketing designers, copywriters, and internal stakeholders to ensure cohesive visual storytelling and consistent brand execution across teams.
  • Presentation and Asset Development: Develop polished, professional, end-to-end presentation templates that minimize the need for end-user customization (Google Slides, PowerPoint); and creation of other marketing collateral that clearly communicate brand messaging and positioning.
  • Market and Trend Awareness: Stay current with the latest design trends, tools, and technologies to continuously improve creative quality, innovation, and execution speed.


Requirements

  • 9+ years of graphic design experience, preferably in technology, AI, SaaS, or similar industries.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, and Canva
  • Strong working knowledge of presentation tools (Google Slides and PowerPoint). Deep understanding of master slides, theme building, and layout systems in both platforms.
  • Experience leveraging generative AI tools for design (e.g., Midjourney, Runway, Adobe Firefly) to enhance creative output and efficiency.
  • Strong understanding of branding, visual storytelling, and integrated marketing principles.
  • Demonstrated experience with design systems, brand guidelines, and visual identity management across diverse channels.
  • Excellent collaboration, organizational, and communication skills, able to handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Self-motivated, proactive learner comfortable working remotely in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Proven experience designing client-facing presentations, such as pitch decks and sales materials, with a focus on clear visual storytelling, data visualization, and adherence to brand standards.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing within AI, tech, or rapidly scaling startup environments.
  • Familiarity with motion graphics, video editing software (After Effects, Premiere Pro), or AI-driven motion tools.
  • Portfolio showcasing integrated marketing campaigns, presentation materials (powerpoint and/or google slides), and consistent brand execution across channels.
  • Familiarity with global and multi-audience brand challenges.

title: Senior Mobile
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.


Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.


Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:


⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.


Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.


No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
A inovaVoip é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em soluções de comunicação em nuvem e telefonia VoIP. Nosso foco é oferecer plataformas estáveis, seguras e escaláveis, desenvolvidas com tecnologias modernas como React, Next.js, Node.js, Supabase e Docker .

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack para atuar na melhoria e otimização de um sistema já existente , preparando-o para produção e escalabilidade . Buscamos um(a) profissional comprometido(a), com visão técnica, responsabilidade e desejo de crescimento.

Responsabilidades
  • Revisar, higienizar e otimizar o código existente, aplicando boas práticas e padrões de arquitetura.
  • Diagnosticar e corrigir erros, gargalos e falhas de lógica.
  • Aprimorar performance e segurança das principais páginas e fluxos do sistema.
  • Garantir o correto funcionamento de permissões, limites e planos de uso.
  • Preparar o ambiente de execução e deployment utilizando Docker e Docker Compose .
  • Implementar melhorias em integrações Realtime (Supabase, Redis, WebRTC).
  • Colaborar com revisões técnicas e propor soluções estruturadas.
  • Contribuir com documentação e padronização de código.
Requisitos Obrigatórios
  • Experiência com React (19.x) e Next.js (15.x) .
  • Domínio em TypeScript (5.x) e boas práticas de tipagem.
  • Experiência com Node.js (20.x) e Express.js .
  • Conhecimento em PostgreSQL / Supabase .
  • Experiência com Redis para cache e gerenciamento de sessões.
  • Habilidade em Docker / Docker Compose .
  • Experiência com Git / GitHub .
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e responsabilidade com prazos e entregas.
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com WebRTC e Asterisk (VoIP) .
  • Vivência com Supabase Realtime ou Sockets .
  • Conhecimento em TailwindCSS e Radix UI .
  • Familiaridade com Clean Code , SOLID e Design Patterns .
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microserviços e CI/CD .
Perfil Ideal

Buscamos um(a) profissional com senso de responsabilidade, organização e mentalidade de melhoria contínua.

Valorizamos pessoas proativas, com iniciativa e comprometimento em entregar resultados de qualidade, que queiram crescer junto com o projeto e influenciar sua evolução técnica .

Modelo de Trabalho
  • 100% remoto
  • Horário flexível (foco em entregas)
  • Contratação PJ / Freelancer
  • Início imediato
Faixa de Remuneração

R$ 6.000 a R$ 10.000 (PJ / mês)

A faixa pode variar conforme experiência e nível técnico.

O que oferecemos
  • Liberdade técnica para propor melhorias e novas soluções.
  • Participação direta em decisões de arquitetura.
  • Acompanhamento técnico e feedback contínuo.
  • Cultura de colaboração e comunicação transparente.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em produto real.

Interessados devem enviar portfólio, GitHub ou LinkedIn com exemplos de projetos utilizando React , Next.js , Node.js , Supabase e Docker .

title: DevOps
description:
Muito prazer, somos a Zallpy!

Somos muito mais que uma empresa de tecnologia; somos uma comunidade diversa, plural e talentosa. Nosso propósito é liderar a transformação digital, com excelência e agilidade, promovendo crescimento mútuo e genuíno em relações éticas e duradouras. Flexibilidade é uma de nossas marcas registradas, atuamos em diferentes modelos e formatos de equipe, mantendo nossa cultura leve, colaborativa e integrada, proporcionando equidade de oportunidades em um espaço onde todos se sintam seguros e ouvidos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenvolver e implementar soluções de infraestrutura, garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e segurança.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e segurança para definir a infraestrutura necessária.
  • Gerenciar incidentes e otimizar processos de deploy e automação.
  • Adotar arquitetura em nuvem (GCP, AWS), visando eficiência e redução de custos.
  • Manter ferramentas DevSecOps e promover a integração contínua entre equipes.
  • Melhorar os processos de CI/CD e monitorar a execução de softwares e aplicações.
  • Trabalhar com as equipes para resolver problemas e identificar melhorias.
  • Implementar pipelines de desenvolvimento e garantir a arquitetura de novos serviços.
  • Gerenciar riscos, utilizar Engenharia do Caos e corrigir erros de forma proativa.
  • Disseminar conhecimento técnico e contribuir para melhorias contínuas.


O que estamos buscando:

  • Experiência em Applications servers (Jboss, Tomcat, websphere, Weblogic, Red Hat JBoss Fuse Service Works, Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Platform);
  • Experiência em Web servers (Apache, Nginx, IIS);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD (Azure Pipelines, Jenkins, etc);
  • Conhecimento em ambiente de cloud (principais como AWS, Azure);
  • Conhecimento em implementação de orquestração de containers OnPremise e AWS (EKS);
  • Conhecimento em ambiente de alta disponibilidade;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de mensageria (Kafka, Rabbit, MQ);
  • Conhecimento em gestão de logs (ELK);
  • Conhecimento em Load Balancing (Nginx, Haproxy, ALB, NLB);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de configuração (Ansible, Puppet, TerraForm);
  • Conhecimento em realizar troubleshooting em aplicações distribuídas e entender o fluxo de comunicação entre aplicações web java, microsserviços, persistência de sessão;
  • Conhecimento em análise de JVM, ajuste de Garbage collector e tunning;
  • Bons conhecimentos em ferramentas de APM (App Dynamics, Elastic APM), Telemetria, Logging e Tracing;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas da cultura DevOps (Infraestrutura como código, CI/CD, Boards; TestLabs, Azure DevOps);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de versionamento e GitOps;
  • Conhecimento em Sistemas Operacionais Linux e Windows server;
  • Conhecimento em scripting (Shell/Bash, Python).


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Ter experiência em core financeiro.

Onde você vai trabalhar:

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação remota.

Modalidade de contratação:

  • CLT;
  • Cooperado;
  • PJ.


O que oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição: Utilizamos o cartão multibenefício EVA, em formato crédito, para proporcionar flexibilidade nas suas compras diárias.*

Plano de Saúde Unimed: Sem coparticipação ou carência para o titular. Dependentes como filhos, cônjuges ou enteados podem ser incluídos com coparticipação.*
